name: GrowthHackers

sources.title: Homepage — community join is via 'Apply to Join' (Tally form t.co/w8drRr) or community.growthhackers.com/signup

conditions: Membership is by application ('Apply to Join' leads to a Tally form) — acceptance is gated, not instant signup
The old self-serve /signup URL returns 404; the live member portal is community.growthhackers.com/signup
requirements: Positioned for founders, heads of growth, marketers, product managers, and innovators — participation should be genuine growth/marketing discourse, not drop-a-link promotion
preparation: A credible growth/marketing profile or reason to join (the apply form vets applicants)
Product story framed as growth learnings if you later share it — the community values methodology over promotion
workflow: Go to https://growthhackers.com/ and click 'Apply to Join' (or open community.growthhackers.com/signup directly)
Complete the application (Tally form) and wait for acceptance
Once inside community.growthhackers.com, participate in discussions/AMAs and share the product only where self-promotion fits
watchFor: Not a launch directory — there is no 'submit your product' route; value is community participation
The old growthhackers.com/signup route is dead (404) — use the community subdomain
The site also sells services, university courses, and sponsorships — expect upsell surfaces
Spam/link-dropping in a curated expert community risks removal
countsAsLive: A member account on community.growthhackers.com is active and any posted thread/profile is publicly visible
unknowns: Whether profile/website links are follow or nofollow
Whether a product-specific listing feature exists inside the member portal
